title: THE BIFURCATION POINT
subtitle: How China escalates determines what the US has to defend against.
condition: China moves militarily against Taiwan within five years.

ifTrue.label: Invasion
ifTrue.consequence: Direct US credibility test under the Taiwan Relations Act — likely conventional war in the first island chain.

ifFalse.label: Blockade or quarantine
ifFalse.consequence: Deterrence test without kinetic engagement — US response calibrated to avoid first-shot framing while preserving freedom-of-navigation.

determinant: Domestic Chinese economic conditions in 2026–2029 likely determine which path the PLA recommends.
